purpose: Validate the proposed municipal budget schema against representative Charlottetown source layouts before SQL migrations.

assertions: Heading and label rows can exist without facts.
A displayed dash must not be converted to zero.
Notes/comments are source cells and not financial facts.
Bell Aliant Centre is the statement entity even when City of Charlottetown appears as a grant line.
Current and prior budgets are separate document-period observations.
Parenthesized allocation values remain reported negative facts.
Reported earnings/loss dashes remain unresolved until reviewed.
OCR extraction method must remain explicit in provenance.
The table spans pages and page 87 supplies the final net-income row.
Repeated zero values are reported zeros, not missing values.
Gross total, external-partner funding, and net total are distinct reported facts.
Parenthesized partner funding is a negative funding-deduction fact.
Reported totals are reconciliation controls and must not be summed with details.
Narrative quantities, dates, and years are not financial facts without an explicit financial field label.
Department, project, description, and strategic alignment preserve raw labels and source rows.
Each detail row can report assessment base, rate per 100 dollars, and tax revenue.
Residency, property class, and business-improvement-area scope form separate dimensions or hierarchy levels.
Reported revenue remains distinct from a derived assessment-times-rate check.
Maturity year belongs to the debt instrument and is not a fiscal-period observation.
Balance, principal, and interest are separate amount types.
A dash in interest must remain distinct from a reported numeric zero.
Total principal plus interest reconciles to the reported combined total.

schema_gaps.finding: budget.fact references document_period_id but the proposed budget.document_period definition does not declare an id.
schema_gaps.resolution: Add document_period.id and bind each document period to a reviewed source_table_column.

schema_gaps.finding: OCR-backed source pages require extraction_method, extractor_version, and confidence or review status in source provenance.
schema_gaps.resolution: Add extraction_method, extractor_version, extraction_confidence, and review_status to source_page while retaining row/cell parser confidence.

schema_gaps.finding: One property-tax source expression reports assessment, rate, denominator, and revenue; the model must allow multiple cited facts from one source cell or expression.
schema_gaps.resolution: Add fact_source as a many-to-many fact-to-cell evidence junction with explicit source roles.

schema_gaps.finding: Multi-page OCR and continuation cases require explicit source-table-to-page membership rather than only page_start/page_end.
schema_gaps.resolution: Add source_table_page with page order, role, page-local bounding box, and optional extraction-method override.

schema_gaps.finding: Document-period uniqueness cannot rely only on raw column label because equivalent labels vary and repeated labels can occur in separate statement scopes.
schema_gaps.resolution: Add source_table_column and make document-period uniqueness depend on document, source column, and period role rather than raw label.
